commit_subject: ci(OMN-17427): rehearse a hook change's pre-push set as a controller worker pushes (#2025)
workflow:
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2025 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#
# Reusable hook push rehearsal for OmniNode repositories (OMN-17427).
#
# A controller fix worker pushes its commit through the repository's pre-push hooks, and a
# refused push loses the fix. A pull request that changes a hook can make every later worker push
# fail (a suite past the push timeout, a hook that refuses, a hook that leaves a file behind), and
# no check ran the pre-push set until a worker pushed.
#
# This workflow runs that set the way a worker does, before the hook change merges. It installs
# the pre-push hook and pushes a sample commit with `git push` to a local bare remote that
# already holds the pull request head, so the pushed range is the remote-head..sample-commit range
# of a worker's fast-forward push. The environment is the worker's (PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1,
# PYTHONPATH unset, the lane variables set) and so is the timeout (1,800 s). The job fails when
# the push is refused, when it runs past the timeout, or when a hook leaves a file in the work tree.
#
# It runs the push only when the pull request changes a path matched by `path-regex`; on any other
# pull request and on any other event it succeeds without a push, so the context always reports and
# a caller can be a required check.
#
# Placement: this repository is public, so the job runs on a GitHub-hosted runner (RULING
# 2026-10-16T07:07:09Z, OMN-19998: CI runners are for private repositories only). Every caller
# gets the same runner and the same hook outcome.
#
# Usage (the caller job id and this file's job id `rehearse` compose the context
# `hook-push-rehearsal / rehearse`):
#
#   jobs:
#     hook-push-rehearsal:
#       permissions:
#         contents: read
#       uses: OmniNode-ai/omnibase_core/.github/workflows/hook-push-rehearsal.yml@<full sha>
#       with:
#         path-regex: '^(\.pre-commit-config\.yaml|scripts/hooks/)'
#         sample-file: src/<package>/<module>.py

name: Hook Push Rehearsal

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      path-regex:
        description: >-
          Extended regular expression over the repository-relative paths the pull request
          changes. A match runs the rehearsal.
        required: true
        type: string
      sample-file:
        description: >-
          A tracked Python source file. The sample commit appends one comment to it, so the
          pushed range holds a Python change and the file-filtered hooks run.
        required: true
        type: string
      push-timeout-seconds:
        description: The controller worker's push timeout (PUSH_TIMEOUT_S in landing_worker_run.py).
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "1800"

jobs:
  rehearse:
    name: rehearse
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 50
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the pull request head with its history
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7

      - name: Decide whether this pull request changes a hook path
        id: detect
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PATH_REGEX: ${{ inputs.path-regex }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" != "pull_request" ]; then
            echo "touched=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "event $EVENT_NAME is not a pull request: the pull request run rehearsed the push"
            exit 0
          fi
          changed="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA...$HEAD_SHA")"
          matched="$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E -e "$PATH_REGEX" || true)"
          if [ -z "$matched" ]; then
            echo "touched=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "no changed path matches $PATH_REGEX: no hook, hook script, preflight or push path changed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "touched=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "changed hook paths:"
          printf '%s\n' "$matched"

      - name: Install the pre-push hook and push a sample commit through it
        if: steps.detect.outputs.touched == 'true'
        env:
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          SAMPLE_FILE: ${{ inputs.sample-file }}
          PUSH_TIMEOUT_S: ${{ inputs.push-timeout-seconds }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The controller worker's push environment (landing_worker_run.py remote_push_script).
          export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
          unset PYTHONPATH
          export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
          export ONEX_LANE=hook-push-rehearsal
          export ONEX_RUN_ID="rehearsal-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"

          uv tool install --quiet pre-commit
          PATH="$(uv tool dir --bin):$PATH"
          export PATH

          test -f .pre-commit-config.yaml || { echo "::error::no .pre-commit-config.yaml"; exit 1; }
          git ls-files --error-unmatch -- "$SAMPLE_FILE" >/dev/null \
            || { echo "::error::sample-file $SAMPLE_FILE is not a tracked file"; exit 1; }

          # The remote already holds the pull request head, as it does when a worker fixes an open
          # pull request; no hook is installed yet, so this push is not judged.
          remote="$RUNNER_TEMP/hook-push-rehearsal-remote.git"
          rm -rf "$remote"
          git init -q --bare "$remote"
          git checkout -q --detach "$HEAD_SHA"
          git push -q "$remote" "$HEAD_SHA:refs/heads/rehearsal"

          # The sample change: one appended comment, two blank lines before it so a formatter
          # check on the file finds nothing to say.
          printf '\n\n# hook-push-rehearsal sample\n' >> "$SAMPLE_FILE"
          git add -- "$SAMPLE_FILE"
          git -c user.name=hook-push-rehearsal -c user.email=hook-push-rehearsal@users.noreply.github.com \
            commit -q -m "hook push rehearsal sample change"

          if ! pre-commit install -t pre-push; then
            echo "::error::LANDING-PRE-PUSH-HOOK-NOT-INSTALLED: a worker pushes nothing without the repository's pre-push suite"
            exit 95
          fi

          log="$RUNNER_TEMP/hook-push-rehearsal-push.log"
          start="$(date +%s)"
          set +e
          timeout --kill-after=30 "$PUSH_TIMEOUT_S" git push "$remote" "HEAD:refs/heads/rehearsal" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
          rc="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
          set -e
          elapsed="$(( $(date +%s) - start ))"
          echo "pre-push set finished in ${elapsed}s (rc=$rc, timeout ${PUSH_TIMEOUT_S}s)"

          if [ "$rc" -eq 124 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 137 ]; then
            echo "::error::the pre-push set ran past the ${PUSH_TIMEOUT_S}s push timeout: a controller worker's push would be killed and the fix lost"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::the pre-push set refused the sample push (rc=$rc): a controller worker's push would be refused"
            exit 1
          fi

          # validate-clean-root: a hook that leaves a file behind (a root __pycache__, a rewritten
          # lock file) refuses the next push from the same tree.
          left="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
          if [ -n "$left" ]; then
            echo "::error::the pre-push set left files in the work tree"
            printf '%s\n' "$left"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "a controller worker's push of a sample change would be accepted"
